title: Privacy Policy
intro:
This Privacy Policy applies to all games and apps published by Taptales Studio ("we", "us") on the Apple App Store, Google Play and our website taptales.net (together, the "Services").

It explains what information our games may collect, why, who it is shared with, how long it is kept and how you can delete it. If a game uses a service listed below, that game's App Store and Google Play privacy details show exactly which data it collects.
body:
## Our Approach

- Most of our games can be played offline, without an account.
- We only collect what a game needs to work, and we never sell personal information.
- Each game's store listing shows the data that specific game collects. If a game collects nothing, its listing says "Data Not Collected".

## Information Stored on Your Device

Our games save your progress on your own device: for example your player name, scores, in-game currency, unlocked items, level progress and settings.

This data stays on your device and is not sent to us. You can erase it with the game's reset option (where available) or by deleting the game.

## Information You Provide

If you contact us (for example by email), we receive the information you choose to send, such as your email address and message. We use it only to reply and to resolve your request.

## Platform Services (Apple and Google)

Some games use features provided by Apple or Google. These are optional and controlled by your device and account settings:

- **Apple Game Center / Google Play Games:** if you sign in, your scores and achievements may be submitted to leaderboards and shown with your gamer nickname. This data is handled by Apple or Google under their own privacy policies ([Apple Game Center](https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/data/en/game-center/), [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy)). We do not receive or store it.
- **Notifications:** reminders are local notifications scheduled on your device. You can turn them off in the game or in your device settings.
- **Purchases:** if a game offers in-app purchases, payments are processed by Apple or Google. We never receive your payment card details.

## Third-Party Services

If a game uses a third-party service for advertising, analytics or crash reporting, that service is listed here together with its purpose and privacy policy, and the game's store privacy details are updated before release.

- **Currently:** none of our games include third-party advertising, analytics or tracking SDKs.

## Advertising and Tracking

We do not track you across apps or websites owned by other companies. If a game ever shows personalised ads, it will ask for your permission first (on iOS through Apple's App Tracking Transparency prompt), and you can change that choice at any time in your device settings.

## Children's Privacy

Our games are designed for a general audience and do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If a game is directed at children, we apply the protections required by applicable law. If you believe a child has sent us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

## How We Use Information

- Provide, maintain and improve our games and support.
- Reply to your messages and requests.
- Keep our Services safe and prevent cheating or abuse.
- Comply with legal obligations.

## Retention and Deletion

- Data stored on your device remains until you reset the game or delete it.
- Support emails are kept only as long as needed to handle your request, then deleted.
- To ask us to delete any information we hold about you, email support@taptales.net. We respond within 30 days.

## Security

We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we work to protect your data.

## Your Rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct or delete your personal information, to object to or restrict its processing, and to withdraw consent. Contact us at support@taptales.net to exercise these rights.

## Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy when our games or the law change. The "Last updated" date at the top shows the latest version. Important changes will also be shown in our games' update notes.

## Contact Us

- **Studio:** Taptales Studio
- **Website:** [taptales.net](https://taptales.net/)
- **Email:** support@taptales.net
